title: Red Light Rising
summary: On Day six, a red light on the mast pulls the whole hill toward the school, and Wren has to get Tilly out through the back.

beats.text: The red light on the mast was a beacon. Every dead thing on Gull Hill turned toward it.
From the window I watched them climb, hundreds, slow and dripping.
"We are right under it," Boyd whispered. "We go out the back."
Tilly held my sleeve. We crept down the stairs on our toes.
The back door was chained. Boyd lifted it link by link.
His old van waited in the yard. Rain hid our steps.
Then my phone buzzed. Cal: Do not go to the boats. Come back up.
lines: Do not go to the boats.

beats.text: "Wren," Cal whispered from the van radio. "Boyd lies. Ask him what he cut."
beats.speaker: cal

beats.text: Boyd's hand tightened on the key. He would not look at me.
Behind us the school doors began to shake.
